name: telnyx
label: Telnyx
description: Telecom API platform for SMS messaging, voice calls, and messaging webhooks.

send_sms.label: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS message using the Telnyx Messages API.

from.label: From
from.description: The sending number or sender ID.

to.label: To
to.description: The destination phone number in E.164 format.

make_call.label: Make Call
make_call.description: Initiate an outbound call using the Telnyx Call Control API.

connection_id.label: Connection ID
connection_id.description: The Telnyx Call Control Application ID (formerly connection ID) used to place the call.

from.label: From
from.description: The caller ID number in E.164 format.

to.label: To
to.description: The destination number or SIP URI.

audio_url.label: Audio URL
audio_url.description: Optional WAV or MP3 URL to play when the call is answered.

webhook_url.label: Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Optional URL that overrides the default Telnyx webhook destination for this call.

timeout_secs.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_secs.description: How long to let the destination ring before timing out.
